description: Header file defining the NetworkChangeNotifierFuchsia class for monitoring network interface changes on Fuchsia OS, including interface event handling, cache management, and external service connections.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierFuchsia
classes.description: Class for monitoring network interface changes on Fuchsia, inheriting from NetworkChangeNotifier, managing interface cache, and handling Fuchsia network events.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type.

methods.name: GetNetworkInterfaceCacheInternal
methods.description: Provides access to the internal network interface cache.

methods.name: OnInterfacesEvent
methods.description: Handles network interface events received from Fuchsia watcher.

methods.name: HandleCacheStatus
methods.description: Handles cache updates and unbinds watcher on errors.
